theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid n), 0 < n → IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → x ∈ U → x ∉ boundarySupport T → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C ∧ IsMinimizingIn C univ ∧ BoundaryVanishes C
